questions.stem: I bought a new bike yesterday. ____ is black.

options.distractor: one 指另一辆，这里说的是刚买的那辆
this 不用于替代前句提到的事物

questions.explanation: 指刚买的那辆（同一个）→ It。

questions.stem: — I like your new watch. — Thanks. I can buy ____ for you, too.

options.distractor: 不能买“你这块”，是买同款的另一块

questions.stem: The population of China is larger than ____ of Japan.

options.distractor: 比较句里替代 the population 要用 that
one 不能替代不可数名词

questions.explanation: 比较句中用 that 替代前面的 the population。

questions.stem: My pen is broken. I'll have to buy a new ____.

options.distractor: it 指原来那支坏笔，不能说“买它”
语法没错，但前面已有 a new，应填代词 one

questions.explanation: 买一支新的（同类的另一支）→ one。

options.text: I have a new dictionary. It is very useful.
I don't like this red bag. Please show me the black one.
The water in the cup is hotter than one in the bottle.
The weather in Beijing is colder than that in Guangzhou.

questions.explanation: water 是不可数名词，比较句中要用 that，不能用 one。

questions.stem: — Did you find your lost key? — No, I couldn't find ____, so I had to make a new ____.

options.distractor: 用反了：找不到的是原来那把
第一空指原来那把钥匙

questions.explanation: 找不到原来那把（it），只好配一把新的（one）。
